headline: Day 17 usage reset has landed
scope: Day 17 usage reset verified on the site owner’s account.

announcement.text:
Day 17/ Bet you thought we forgot, but no, it’s reset day today.

Also good time to remind you to get Daybreak Blue access, it only takes 15 mins and you don’t want to have to do it in the middle of an incident.
announcement.translation:
第 17 天：你们肯定以为我们忘了，但没有，今天是重置日。

也趁这个机会提醒大家开通 Daybreak Blue 访问权限，只需要 15 分钟；你肯定不想在故障发生时才去办。

timingSource.translation: 将在明天 PST 上午 10 点前落地。

note: The site owner confirmed restored usage on their account on October 23 (UTC+8). No separate completion post from Tibo was found. The exact execution time is unknown. Earlier timing reply and estimated deadline are preserved.
